provenance.scope: Same binary, generated Metal RGBA16F fixture, SDR premultiplied black matte, H.264 hardware encoder, 24 fps. Fresh native objects per trial. Compile/test excluded. Independent decode excluded. Annex B has no authored container timestamps; native callback checks every exact 1/24 PTS and duration. Not the product renderer or worker.

host.backend: Metal system default device / required hardware VideoToolbox encoder

fixture.input: Metal RGBA16F; alpha=0.5 or 1 by alternating 32px blocks; rgb=half(((x+3*i)%256,(y+5*i)%256,(x+y+i)%256)/256)*alpha
fixture.output: black-matte BT.709 BGRA8 -> hardware H.264 YUV420 video range; same f32 LUT for both paths
